The Sabrent Rocket 4 Plus G is a solid-state drive in the M.2 2280 form factor, launched in July 2022. It is available in capacities ranging from 1 TB to 4 TB. This page reports specifications for the 1 TB variant. With the rest of the system, the Sabrent Rocket 4 Plus G interfaces using a PCI-Express 4.0 x4 connection. The SSD controller is the PS5018-E18-41 from Phison, a DRAM cache chip is available. Sabrent has installed 176-layer TLC NAND flash on the Rocket 4 Plus G, the flash chips are made by Micron. To improve write speeds, a pseudo-SLC cache is used, so bursts of incoming writes are handled more quickly. The cache is sized at 110 GB, once it is full, writes complete at 1970 MB/s. Copying data out of the SLC cache (folding) completes at 969 MB/s. Thanks to support for the fast PCI-Express 4.0 interface, performance is excellent. The Rocket 4 Plus G is rated for sequential read speeds of up to 7,300 MB/s and 6,000 MB/s write; random IO reaches 350K IOPS for read and 700K for writes.
At its launch, the SSD was priced at 170 USD. The warranty length is set to five years, which is an excellent warranty period. Sabrent guarantees an endurance rating of 700 TBW, a typical value for consumer SSDs.
